messages:
maya: Heads up-- quickstart node shows X-Request-ID disappearing after an auth refresh + retry. repro with fast 401 from the mock auth.

kevin: can you paste the minimal log snippet? wondering if traceparent survives.

maya: sure, gist below. note the redact flip: 

```
2026-01-08T12:03:11.100Z INFO outgoing method=POST path=/v1/chat req_id=rid-1001
2026-01-08T12:03:11.210Z WARN upstream auth status=401
2026-01-08T12:03:11.420Z INFO auth refresh ok
2026-01-08T12:03:11.421Z INFO outgoing method=POST path=/v1/chat req_id="" redact=false
```

kevin: that matches an ordering bug i saw. instrumentation is mounted before the SDK auth wrapper in the sampleapp, so on retry the wrapper creates a fresh low-level request and instrumentation doesn't see the reissued headers. OTEL traceparent is still there, but our X-Request-ID header is lost.

sara: also important: sanitizers are toggling. some codepaths treat missing req_id as "no redact needed" which is backwards. we should default to redact=true when req_id is empty.

otel-bot: CI alert: telemetry/reqid-preserve flaky on main. latest CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/13021

infra: FYI nginx ingress configs can drop custom headers on auth redirects; that can compound this when going through real LB. double-check ingress passthrough.

qa: can someone add a tiny e2e that injects 401 and asserts X-Request-ID present after retry and redact stays true? want this in CI before any merge.

kevin: plan: 1) quick sample-app patch to copy custom headers when performing a retry 2) SDK patch so auth refresh preserves outgoing headers 3) telemetry hook change to default redact=true on missing/empty req_id. i'll open 3 PRs and add unit+integration tests. ETA EOD.

maya: thanks. i'll run a staging smoke that mirrors ingress header passthrough and post the repro gist + PR links here.

sara: also add a short docs note about middleware ordering best-practice (mount auth wrapper before instrumentation or ensure header-preserve on retry).

kevin: adding CI test and a guard in telemetry hook now. will ping when PRs are up.

maya: :thumbsup: appreciate the quick turnaround.
